data.name: ExcelReaderNode_Desc
data.value: Reads Excel (.xlsx) and CSV files and emits each row as a data record with its columns in metadata.

data.name: CsvReaderNode_Desc
data.value: Reads delimited files (CSV, TSV, TXT) with automatic format detection and emits each row with its columns in metadata.

data.name: DataFormatConverterNode_Desc
data.value: Converts tabular and structured files directly between Excel (.xlsx), CSV, and JSON formats.

data.name: DataLookupNode_Desc
data.value: Looks up and joins information from the current file against an external table (Excel, CSV, or JSON), injecting matching columns into metadata.

data.name: SqliteDatabaseSinkNode_Desc
data.value: Inserts a historical audit record into a SQLite database with metadata and traceability for each processed file.

data.name: CsvExportNode_Desc
data.value: Exports and accumulates metadata from each processed file into a configurable delimited CSV file.

data.name: ExcelReportGeneratorNode_Desc
data.value: Accumulates metadata from processed files and generates a structured Excel (.xlsx) report when the workflow completes.
